Subject: Acme POC - Post-call recap & proposed success criteria

Hi Jordan & Priya,

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning - really appreciate the context on the search relevancy and content ingestion pain points. Recap + suggested next steps below.

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary goal: improve search relevance for product docs and customer support content (reduce irrelevant results and time-to-answer).
- Scope for the POC: product docs + top 5 support categories (~60k docs).
- Success criteria (proposed):
  - Precision@10 improvement of at least 12% vs current baseline OR 30% reduction in mean time-to-first-relevant-result during sample queries.
  - Average query latency under 350ms for 95th percentile during expected load (10 qps)
  - Ingestion pipeline complete (delta + backfill) within the first week

Redwood deliverables (what we propose)
- 2-week POC: week 0 = setup & ingestion, week 1 = evaluation & tuning.
- Provide ingestion scripts, sample mapping, and quantized model variants for cost-sensitive testing.
- Weekly status updates and a short demo at the end of week 1.

Action items / owners
- Acme: provide a sample export (S3) of 10k representative docs + query logs for baseline (owner: Jordan) - target: Wed 24 Jun
- Acme: confirm success criteria and any additional KPIs (owner: Priya) - target: Wed 24 Jun
- Redwood: provide POC onboarding guide, initial ingestion script, and calendar for kickoff (owner: Marissa) - target: Tue 23 Jun
- Redwood SE: review query log format and advise on metrics to collect (owner: Rishi) - target: Wed 24 Jun

Attachments: acme_poc_success_criteria.docx (draft), redwood-poc-setup-guide.pdf

If this looks right I can lock the kickoff for Tue 23 Jun at 10am PT (Calendly link below) and start the ingestion work.

Thanks - looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
